title: Osier: branch-local row refinement for extensible records with GADTs
description: The Osier language: an Elm-family checker and a Lean mechanization for row-polymorphic records under branch-local GADT refinement and locally abstract types. The deposit carries the compiler, the mechanization, the fixture gate and the corpus byte-identity manifest, the artifact documentation, and the paper.
